metadata.scope: Allow renaming a tag master (tag_definitions) `code` via the existing admin PATCH /admin/tags/:tagId endpoint in apps/api. Extend UpdateTagDefinitionInput with optional `code` (new code) and `expectedCode` (required when `code` is present; optimistic compare-and-swap), change updateTagDefinition to return a discriminated union so UNIQUE(code) conflicts surface as `code_conflict` and optimistic mismatches as `stale`, and missing CAS tokens as `missing_expected_code`. The route maps these to 409 tag_code_conflict and 409 tag_stale_conflict respectively, emits a dedicated audit action admin.tag.code_renamed with before {code} / after {code}, and keeps admin.tag.updated for label/category changes. member_tags references tag_id (PRIMARY KEY member_id,tag_id) so rename does NOT break referential integrity; a regression test proves it. auditLog.ts is NOT changed (AuditTargetType already has 'tag'; AuditAction is RepoBrand<string> with no enum). No D1 schema migration (optimistic concurrency uses expectedCode CAS with UPDATE WHERE tag_id AND code, no version column needed). No apps/web change (admin tag master CRUD UI page is not yet built; the code-edit UI wiring is formalized as a separate unassigned task). specs/01-api-schema.md invariant #13 is revised from 'code immutable' to 'code renameable with audit', which SUPERSEDES the issue-1035 issue_optimization_note decision. This workflow implements local code/spec changes and captures deterministic evidence; commit, push, PR, staging deploy and Issue state changes are user-gated. Issue #1069 was closed externally on 2026-06-03; this workflow performed no Issue mutation (PR uses Refs #1069, never Closes).

metadata.issue_optimization_note: Issue #1069 (task-issue-1035-followup-002) was filed 2026-06-01 framing tag `code` rename as HIGH risk for member_tags referential integrity (AC-3). Re-checked against the CURRENT schema: member_tags is keyed by tag_id (apps/api/migrations/0002_admin_managed.sql:43-51 'PRIMARY KEY (member_id, tag_id)'), NOT code — so rename is referentially SAFE and AC-3 is satisfied by design. The real concern surface narrows to (a) UNIQUE(code) conflict, (b) audit old/new code, (c) seed/static-manifest drift. The parent task issue-1035 explicitly recorded 'code is IMMUTABLE, rename out of scope to avoid seed/UI drift, audit ambiguity, and 409 churn' in its artifacts issue_optimization_note; THIS task SUPERSEDES that decision per user-approved ADR (code rename allowed). seed drift is harmless: 0004_seed_tags.sql uses INSERT OR IGNORE keyed by tag_id (idempotent, insert-only) so a renamed code is neither reverted nor conflicting on re-run. audit ambiguity is resolved by a dedicated admin.tag.code_renamed action carrying before/after code. 409 churn is split into tag_code_conflict (UNIQUE) vs tag_stale_conflict (optimistic CAS). The change is a backward-compatible body extension of the EXISTING PATCH endpoint — no new endpoint, no schema migration, no apps/web change, no auditLog.ts type change.
